stories.headline: Both parties have agreed
stories.dek: Kyiv says it learned from the media. The Kremlin would say only that contacts continue. Six Ukrainian energy sites were hit inside a day.

stories.headline: Forty per cent more than what?
stories.dek: Microsoft’s new accelerator is specified almost entirely in ratios. There is no absolute throughput figure anywhere in the announcement.

stories.kicker: The Rabbit Hole · Close-Up Card Magic
stories.headline: The one craft that promises to deceive you
stories.dek: A hundred and forty-two thousand people in one forum ban revealing method. The two biggest teaching channels exist to reveal it, and hold two and three-quarter million subscribers.

stories.kicker: Singapore · The Subsidy Below The Line
stories.headline: The clinics opened; the masks did not
stories.dek: Haze consultations are capped at ten dollars from Monday. The index that releases N95s has still never been reached, five weeks in.

stories.headline: England still cuts it; Italy owns it
stories.dek: A tensioned leather saddle is a suspension bridge, not a cushion. One construction choice decides whether you own it for thirty years or until the leather goes.

stories.headline: Priced at last, and not here
stories.dek: XREAL’s Android XR glasses finally have a number in four currencies. Singapore dollars are not one of them, and the maker’s own page disagrees with itself about where it ships.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · Three Hundred Worldwide
stories.headline: Limited worldwide, sold in one country
stories.dek: Casio’s ¥748,000 Oceanus runs to 300 numbered pieces and reaches them through Japanese partner shops only. Its predecessor cost ¥66,000 less in twice the quantity.

stories.kicker: Culture Desk · One Critic Against Seven
stories.headline: Two thousand screens, one logged review
stories.dek: A wide-release western has a single critic on Metacritic. The 1947 film it remakes has seven, and a better score.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · The Co-Twin Control
stories.headline: Threefold became sixty-five per cent, then nothing
stories.dek: A Swedish twin cohort re-ran the screen-time finding against siblings who shared a household. What survived that did not survive multiple testing.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The Dollar Did The Repricing
stories.headline: A hawkish speech into a closed bond market
stories.dek: Cleveland’s president argued for a restrictive stance on a day the Treasury market was shut. The answer comes today, and Wednesday’s inflation print is the real question.

stories.headline: The trick that did nothing, measured
stories.dek: One leg trained through full range, the other only in the stretched half, for eight weeks. The difference between them was minus one point four square centimetres.

stories.headline: Four nights at the National Stadium, in April
stories.dek: The promoter publishes the dates and routes the price to a third party. Two of this month’s best things are free, and one of them is running today.

stories.headline: The word Malaysia invented for the kapchai
stories.dek: P-hailing exists in Malaysian statute and nowhere else on earth. In early 2027 the state will set a minimum income for it — co-funded by the platform it is regulating.
